g_notes: SKIP — compensation & benefits (salary, bonuses, stock, benefits packages) is a different product world (comp/reward), not skills assessment or hiring; no assessment-relevant angle to transplant it into.

SKIP — organizational citizenship behavior is workplace-culture/performance content (altruism, courtesy, sportsmanship at work), squarely in the engagement/performance-management territory the brand scope marks off-limits, not hiring or assessment.
SKIP — organizational design (strategy-to-structure fit, OD principles) is an org-development/consulting subject, not skills assessment or hiring.
SKIP — compensation analysis (salary benchmarking, pay equity) belongs to comp & benefits, a different product world than skills assessment/hiring.

SKIP — this is a competency model for the HR profession's own skills (business acumen, data literacy, etc.), i.e. general HR L&D content, not about assessing candidates or building hiring assessments.
